review_ExtensionDict_class: review the _ExtensionDict class which provides dict-like access to protobuf extension fields on message instances
use_getitem_access_extension: use __getitem__ to retrieve the current value of a protobuf extension field by its handle
use_setitem_set_extension: use __setitem__ to set a scalar extension field value with type checking on a protobuf message
use_contains_check_extension: use __contains__ to check if a specific extension field is populated on a protobuf message instance
use_FindExtensionByName_lookup: use _FindExtensionByName to look up a known extension field descriptor by its full name
